description: This Java class 'AuditAware' is a base class intended for auditing purposes in JPA entities. It tracks creation and modification timestamps and user identifiers, supporting automatic population via Spring Data JPA Auditing features.

classes.name: AuditAware
classes.description: A base class for JPA entities providing auditing functionality such as creation and modification timestamps and user info. Uses Spring Data JPA auditing annotations.

methods.name: getCreatedDate
methods.description: Getter for createdDate, returns the timestamp when the entity was created.

methods.name: getCreatedBy
methods.description: Getter for createdBy, returns the user who created the entity.

methods.name: getModifiedDate
methods.description: Getter for modifiedDate, returns the last modification timestamp.

methods.name: getModifiedBy
methods.description: Getter for modifiedBy, returns the user who last modified the entity.

methods.name: getVersion
methods.description: Getter for version, used for optimistic locking in JPA.
